references.text: The first census of the tribe of Dan showed 62,700 men, providing a basis for comparison with the figure here of 64,400.
The preceding verse mentions the clan of the Shuhamites descended from Shuham, and verse 43 gives the total number for this clan.
Dan's son Hushim is mentioned here; he is the ancestor of the Shuhamites referred to in Numbers 26:42–43.
